query: Distant Horizons VRAM requirement Sodium Iris 2026 heavy modpack 64GB RAM
answer: For Distant Horizons VRAM requirement with Sodium Iris 2026 heavy modpack and 64GB RAM, the sources suggest a minimum of 4GB, with 6GB being the recommended amount for optimum performance without significant stuttering, especially below 256 chunks. Allocating more than 10GB can be problematic for the Java Garbage Collector unless using heavy terrain generation mods. For best performance with shaders, users are advised to allocate at least 8GB, with 12GB or more being optimal for systems with 32GB of RAM. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for the exact VRAM requirement for Sodium Iris 2026 heavy modpack specifically but suggest careful consideration for higher RAM allocations.

results.title: Distant Horizons & Iris Shaders - 256 Chunk Fabric Modpack
results.content:
Four gigabytes is the minimum and six is the recommended figure. Two gigabytes crashes the game outright. Going past ten can actually hurt, because Java's garbage collector handles a very large heap poorly, so only allocate that much if you are also running a heavy terrain generation mod on top. [...] Distant Horizons builds its far terrain on the CPU, so this pack asks more of your processor and memory than of your graphics card, while the shader pack you add asks the opposite. That split is what makes the combination heavy on modest hardware. Memory is where most failed installs go wrong, and the requirements are blunt about it. [...] ## About
